summary: Multisite Hotfix Testing Complete - All critical post-migration fixes verified. RDS Settings, Chat, Content Library, Site Settings, and User Switching all work correctly with X-Main-Site-ID header. Data isolation between main sites confirmed working.
features_verified: ✅ Main sites list shows multiple sites (Radiogroep MFY/GRK, DBNT Studio, etc.)
✅ RDS Settings page loads at /radiogroep/rds with configuration
✅ Chat page loads at /radiogroep/chat with team messages
✅ Site Settings shows 8 team members at /radiogroep/team
✅ User switching via dropdown - 'Login as User' option works
✅ After user switch, URL preserves /radiogroep/ prefix
✅ Navigation within main site preserves the prefix
✅ Data isolation - DBNT Studio shows different/no data compared to Radiogroep
context_for_next_testing_agent: All multisite hotfix features are working correctly. The X-Main-Site-ID header is properly used for data isolation across RDS Settings, Chat, Content Library, and User endpoints. User switching preserves the main site context by navigating to /{mainSiteSlug}/shows after switch. Data isolation verified - Radiogroep has 132 content items while DBNT Studio has 0.
rca_of_the_issue: The original bug was that after multisite architecture migration, many features were still using team_id instead of main_site_id from X-Main-Site-ID header. The fixes involved: 1) Backend endpoints now use get_chat_query_filter helper that checks X-Main-Site-ID header first, 2) Frontend navigate() calls now preserve the mainSiteSlug prefix (e.g., /radiogroep/shows), 3) switchToUser in TeamSettingsPage navigates to mainSite-prefixed URL after switch.
